[[File:DeliaDunes.png|250px|right|thumb|Brass Dragoons in Delia Dunes.]]
{{Quote|Desert area famous for its barking sands. Said to be formed from a celestial beast's bones.|Description}}
'''Delia Dunes''' {{J|デライラ砂丘|Deraira sakyū}} is a desert location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It can be placed on the World Map after "Mission #017: Desert Patrol" is completed and is the site of the storyline "Mission #018: Quiet Sands".

Delia Dunes is also the site of "Mission #034: Magewyrm", "Mission #066: A Dragon's Aid", and "Mission #091: Challengers?". It can be freed in "Mission #254: Delia Dunes".

==Story==
In "Mission #018: Quiet Sands", [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] is confronted by [[Llednar Twem]]. A seam is also located here, and Marche and Llednar were teleported to the shrine of the fifth Crystal, the [[Human]] Crystal. When Llednar attempts to use his [[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance enemy abilities#Omega|Omega]] skill, [[Cid Randell|Judgemaster Cid]] intervenes and sends Llednar to prison. Marche is then free to battle the Human Totema, [[Mateus (Tactics Advance)|Mateus]].
